lines.text: Jesus passes through Galilee teaching His disciples that the Son of Man will be killed and rise after three days.
In the house at Jericho, the disciples are silent because on the way they had argued about who was greatest.
Jesus says whoever wants to be first must be last of all, and He takes a little child in His arms.
John says they tried to stop a man driving out demons in Jesus' name, but Jesus says whoever is not against us is for us.
Jesus says it is better to enter the kingdom of God with one hand than to be thrown into hell with two.
